mapper.select: select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, d.dept_name as deptName from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where r.role_key = 'collab_member' and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' order by u.user_name

select count(1) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and r.role_key = 'collab_member' and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0'
